description: Writes a text custom field on a Clio matter. Refuses non-text fields; an existing value needs confirm_overwrite: true. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

confirm_overwrite.description: Required (true) to replace a value that is already set.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Clio matter id (digits) from find_matter or list_open_matters. Not the display number.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

name: update_matter_custom_field
title: Update matter custom field
